research_question: Can a fixed small causal Transformer use observable structured URL/DOM semantics to recover browser-side behavior in fully held-out vulnerability families from black-box traces?
hypothesis: Adding deterministic, label-free URL and markup projections will improve held-out postmessage_origin and dom_sink_injection behavior recovery and Counterexample@10 without requiring a larger model.

training_budget.checkpoint_selection: maximum old-family IID accuracy plus old-family validation accuracy

data_protocol.split_rule: Hold out complete vulnerability families; never split near-duplicate program instances across train and holdout.

ablation.treatment: same trace plus deterministic URL/markup/numeric semantic projection

failure_conditions: Either held-out family has mean behavior agreement below 0.85.
Any old family regresses by more than 0.02 against the raw-feature control.
The result depends on source, family, Rule IR, CWE, intended output, or counterexample leakage.
The effect does not repeat across three independent seeds.

decision_policy.pass: Consolidate the structured projection and families into the research curriculum.
decision_policy.fail: Keep the experiment research-only, classify the root cause, and make the smallest representation/data change before any scale increase.
